content:
This MR addresses two main issues: A bug preventing source code files from being processed and embedded.
Refactors the data embedding pipeline to store processed data and embeddings for each item (issue, MR, commit, code file, epic) in individual JSON files in Azure Blob Storage, rather than a single large file.
Key Changes: storage/blob_storage.py:
Added the missing sanitize_for_filename static method to the BlobStorage class. This resolves an AttributeError and allows correct blob name generation for processed code files.
scripts/initialize_pipeline.py:
Refactored chunk_and_embed_data function:
Modified to process, chunk, embed, and upload data for each source item (issues, MRs, commits, code files, epics) individually.
Each successfully processed item's chunks and embeddings are now stored in a unique JSON file in the gitlab-processed Azure Blob Storage container (e.g., processed_code_PROJECTID_SANITIZEDPATH.json, processed_issue_PROJECTID_ISSUEID.json).
Introduced an internal helper function _process_embed_and_upload_item_chunks to handle the embedding and uploading logic per item.
Enhanced error handling to log issues for individual items without halting the entire pipeline.
Removed the generation of the single data_with_embeddings.json file.
Added more detailed logging to the code file processing loop to improve diagnostics for chunk generation.
